And you? Do you have children?
This line is not moving at all, is it? Are those two yours?
Yes, they are. I have two children: a son and a daughter.
Lovely. How old are they?
My son is eight and my daughter is six. And you?
One boy, ten. He never gets tired. Is this your first time in London?
Yes, it is. We are here for two weeks.
And whereabouts do you live back home, if you do not mind me asking?
Sorry, I don't understand. Can you say that again, more slowly?
Of course. Where do you live in Brazil?
In São Paulo. I work in the afternoon, and my husband works in the morning.
That is organised. Who takes them to school?
He takes them at seven thirty, and I help with the homework after dinner. And you? Do you work at the weekend?
Never. Saturday is for football, and I am very bad at it. Look, the line is moving.
At the weekend we are all together.

Our week is always the same, and honestly that is the only way it works. My wife starts very early, so she leaves the house at half past six and she does not see the children in the morning. I take them to school at eight, and I work from home until three. My son has football on Tuesday and on Thursday, and my daughter has a music class on Wednesday. She practises every evening for twenty minutes, and she never forgets, which surprises me. We have dinner all together at seven, and after dinner they do their homework at the kitchen table, because in their rooms nothing happens. At the weekend everything changes: nobody works, my wife cooks something big on Saturday, and on Sunday we go to my mother's house. That is our week. It is not exciting, but the children like it.

Good afternoon, this is a message from the school office for the parents of the younger children. Next week is a short week, so please read this carefully. On Monday the school opens at the normal time, but it closes at midday, because the teachers have a meeting in the afternoon. On Tuesday and Wednesday everything is normal. On Thursday the children go to the science museum, so they need a small bag with water and a sandwich, and they come back at four instead of three. Friday is a holiday and the school is closed all day. One more thing: your child does not need to bring homework on Thursday, because there is no class in the afternoon. If you have a question, the office is open from eight to five. Thank you.
